scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to acknowledge customer distress at [03:15] when she explained her freezing house and elderly grandmother shivering under blankets.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked for the smart thermostat model again at [08:10] after customer explicitly stated 'Hive Active Heating v3 kit' at [00:45].

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to ask diagnostic questions about 2.4 GHz interference or legacy security modes before splitting bands.

grader.scenario: Smart thermostat and 2.4GHz IoT devices failing to connect due to band-steering
grader.notes: Agent successfully resolved smart home IoT pairing by splitting 2.4GHz and 5GHz Wi-Fi frequencies, but ignored customer distress over a freezing household and asked for the thermostat model again after it was already given.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net broadband technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Holds announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Danica throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [03:15] Customer: 'Our house is freezing cold! It is the middle of November, my elderly grandmother lives with us, and the radiators are completely shut off... we have been shivering under blankets for two days...' ... [03:35] Agent: 'The router settings show band-steering is enabled by default across all residential firmware releases.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately restated the band-steering pairing incompatibility at [01:30].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [00:45] Customer: 'The thermostat kit is the Hive Active Heating v3 system.' ... [08:10] Agent: 'Which exact model of smart thermostat are you trying to pair again?'

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent split the Wi-Fi frequencies and assisted with device connection.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent remained professional and polite throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent did not probe into signal attenuation or wireless channel congestion.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed thermostat paired, boiler fired up, and radiators warmed up.
